verdict.rationale: Pigment documents detailed application histories down to the data block level with full visibility into edit events, plus an Audit Trail API that exports application events to a SIEM, which covers the logging half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows rolling changes back; staging environments are a related control, not a rollback. missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of model changes, explicit confirmation that history records who changed what and when, independent or hands-on corroboration.
